parameters.query: SELECT postulacion_id, ticket_id, candidato, email, vacancy_id, vacante, vacante_codigo, estado, prioridad, applied_at, score, prioridad_compatibilidad FROM talentflow.vw_bot_candidatos WHERE vacancy_id::text = $1 OR vacante_codigo ILIKE $1 OR vacante ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
